children: Novotel Kolkata Hotel & Residences has appointed Neerajita Kundu as People & Culture Manager. With over 11 years of experience in hospitality human resources, Kundu brings expertise across people operations, talent acquisition, employee engagement, learning and development, employee relations and organisational culture.

Kundu has worked with The Lalit Great Eastern Kolkata, Neotia Hospitality, Hyatt Regency Kolkata and Fortune Park Hotels by ITC. Most recently, she served as Human Resource Manager at Fortune Park Hotels by ITC, where she supported the property during its pre-opening phase. She previously spent three years with Hyatt Regency Kolkata as Assistant Manager – Human Resources.

In her new role, Kundu will lead the People & Culture function at Novotel Kolkata, focusing on employee engagement, talent development, learning and development and professional growth. She will also work to strengthen a workplace culture centred on trust, communication, recognition, and belonging among the hotel’s Heartists.

Commenting on the appointment, Rajneesh Kumar, General Manager, Novotel Kolkata Hotel & Residences, said, “We are pleased to welcome Neerajita Kundu to Novotel Kolkata. Her strong understanding of the hospitality landscape, coupled with her extensive experience across human resources and people management, will add significant depth to our leadership team.

People are at the heart of hospitality, and Neerajita’s vision closely aligns with our commitment to building a workplace that encourages growth, celebrates individual contributions and fosters a strong sense of belonging. We look forward to her leadership in further nurturing our Heartists and strengthening a culture that enables our people to thrive while delivering memorable experiences to our guests.”

Kundu aims to strengthen a culture of learning, recognition and engagement while creating an environment where employees feel valued and empowered to grow. Beyond her professional pursuits, she has an interest in poetry and music.
